name: Pine Island Camp
description_short: A six-week, single-session overnight camp for boys ages 9 to 15 on an island in Great Pond in the Belgrade Lakes of central Maine. Campers live without electricity or phones, pick their own daily activities and wilderness trips, and write letters home.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on an island in Great Pond, a lake. Campers swim, row, sail and take out boats during free time. Waterfront staff have WSI and Lifeguard certification and also go through the camp's own in-camp training.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Tuition amounts have no year attached. They appear next to the 2027 dates, but confirm they are the 2027 rates.

Tuition is chosen by the family: 'True Cost' is $15,600, 'Subsidized' is $12,500 (honor system), and needs-based camperships are also offered (average award $4,500). The session price is left null because there is no single price.
Enrollment for new families opens 'October 15' (probably 2026, two days after today), and new families must have a 1:1 meeting with the director before they are accepted.
Campers live without electricity or phones. Parents hear from them only through handwritten letters, weekly emails from camp, and calls to the office.
The site footer says ©2025, but the camp dates listed are for 2027.
